body: Path rules for every remote TermAl runner, learned 2026-11-01. (1) No path component named target, dist, node_modules or a dot-directory the watcher ignores may appear in the job worktree OR in TMPDIR/TEMP/the test home. TermAl's workspace_watch.rs:393 is_ignored_workspace_file_event_path and claude_gate_write_guard.rs:78 match those names over the WHOLE absolute path (bug w-a259a47bb144). A runner that set TMPDIR to <worktree>/target/.tmp got 19 false failures (gate_write_guard and watcher tests) in the Mac batch gate test-98aab07f. Put TMPDIR and the test home under the worktree's own .tmp/. (2) On Windows, keep paths short and have LongPathsEnabled = 1: the first Windows B layout gave 1273 false failures, and the short layout with LongPathsEnabled = 0 gave 5 "Filename too long" (w-3551b1d9102f). (3) A launch from a session belonging to another project must be standalone (TERMAL_BASE_URL, TERMAL_SESSION_ID and TERMAL_CLI removed, giving UNTRACKED), or registration is refused with a 400 (w-5e2f3fba987a). (4) Use the local fingerprint, with commit + tree as the cross-host identity. (5) Look up the item reference before quoting it in a note. Don't write a guessed or placeholder w-… id.
